original_external_audit_lineage.continuity_scope: Fitted-estimator fingerprint recorded from trusted v2 checkpoint after the original audit, before replacement fitting. Revenue source/features/data remained unchanged; net policy and scoring wording are outside this component fingerprint. Original v2 recipe remains pinned; later same-recipe builds reproduce consumed metrics within declared tolerance, not fresh evidence.

final_local_continuity_before_engineerin.scope: Exact local fitted equality is recorded separately from a pinned-recipe cross-platform reproduction. Any fitted-byte difference also requires actual consumed-audit loss equality within 1e-9 absolute tolerance. These are reproducibility checks, never fresh model selection.

original_external_audit_lineage.sequential_engineering_development: V2 majority-share failure, v3 cohort-regression failure, and v4 cohort-regression failure remain rejected and consumed. V5 passed every unchanged acceptance check on its separately reserved 900 generated businesses as the fourth exploratory cycle. The first V5 measurement is preserved; subsequent runs require unchanged serving source, policies, protocol/addendum, real/synthetic recipes and reproduced metrics/counts/identity/target hashes. This remains conditional exploratory engineering evidence, not a corrected unconditional single-shot claim. The real revenue component, synthetic comparator and generator remain frozen; the final median_share12/guard65 policy was chosen from original development only, with no consumed target-dependent corrections.

synthetic_component_reference.scope: Original synthetic net estimator and validation-selected blend, excluding expense/transfer projection. Recipe equality is portable; learned fingerprint equality is checked separately locally. Recorded from trusted v2 checkpoint without generating any audit case.

original_external_audit_lineage.archive_presentation_correction: Only the engineering v2/v3/v4 Markdown links to full JSON were corrected to their respective preserved archive basenames. Original JSON measurement values and all original protocol document bytes remain unchanged. Markdown archive digests below reference the corrected presentations.

predetermined_acceptance.scope: Finite-sample no-material-regression engineering tolerances, not a claimed accuracy gain or validated lending policy. Actual error improvement and uncertainty are reported separately.

engineering_v5_first_measurement.tolerance_scope: Floating-point regression reproduction precision, not relaxed model acceptance thresholds or a new independent audit
engineering_v5_first_measurement.sequential_scope: Fourth exploratory cycle after three preserved failures. Descriptive uncertainty conditions on this final frozen candidate and generated cohort; it does not correct prior selection/revision signals or establish real borrower capacity.
engineering_v5_first_measurement.reproduction_metric_tolerances_scope: Strict same-local-fitted reruns. Differing-fitted portable same-recipe variants independently pass unchanged engineering gates plus every original-target point and exact structural invariants; any strict metric equality failure remains recorded.

engineering_v5_platform_continuity.manifest_origin: Reconstructed on the original Mac platform after initial V5 measurement from unchanged consumed positions only; raw ID and float64 target hashes match first measurement exactly. No fitting or scoring occurred during reference reconstruction.
engineering_v5_platform_continuity.errors_use: Stored first-measurement Mac targets after every native point passes identity/date/value continuity; native raw target hash and maximum absolute difference stay visible
engineering_v5_platform_continuity.same_local_fitted_rule: Require exact source/policy/docs/recipes, original target identity/count/scoring invariants, all five unchanged gates, and strict metric reproduction at the previously recorded precisions
engineering_v5_platform_continuity.different_fitted_portable_rule: Require exact source/policy/docs/recipes, pointwise original target continuity, exact IDs/slice/count/scoring/weight invariants and independent passage of all five unchanged gates against stored original targets. Report actual metric deltas and strict loss-reproduction FAIL without calling the build byte-identical or adding independent evidence.
engineering_v5_platform_continuity.external_real_revenue_rule: Separate consumed external revenue reproduction still requires original provider/overall metric equality within 1e-9 absolute tolerance.
engineering_v5_platform_continuity.reason: Linux same-recipe fitting/regeneration differed from Mac raw future-target bytes and synthetic-net metric values despite exact source, IDs and scoring counts. Source recipes and acceptance thresholds were not changed in response. The actual first Mac measurement remains immutable; this distinction concerns portability regression on already consumed targets, never model selection or a fresh audit.

revenue_continuity.scope: Exact local fitted equality is recorded separately from a pinned-recipe cross-platform reproduction. Any fitted-byte difference also requires actual consumed-audit loss equality within 1e-9 absolute tolerance. These are reproducibility checks, never fresh model selection.

reproduced_losses.scope: Same frozen recipe/candidate with reproduced primary overall and provider losses/counts. This certifies metric reproduction at stated precision, not pointwise identical forecasts or new untouched labels.

selection_metadata.test_protocol: Fresh Eurostat six-country and whole-provider ONS audits, plus new engineering seed cohort, are constructed explicitly only after model freeze. Previous ABS/Canada, Uzbekistan and original synthetic test outcomes are consumed legacy regression benchmarks.
selection_metadata.selection_metric: Provider-balanced macro per-history-normalized validation MAE; training loss weight equal by provider; no final test outcomes used

selection_metadata.temporal_scope: Holdouts are provider-local terminal years; Uzbekistan training through December 2025 overlaps some Australian/Canadian holdout dates. selection_metadata.limitations: Original retail turnover and service value are aggregate revenue proxies, not independent firm cash receipts. Native currency units remain separate and only dimensionless errors are pooled. Survey revisions, correlated economic shocks, Uzbekistan short post-methodology histories, and cross-country aggregate-to-borrower transfer limit claims. short_history_policy: The same observed final targets are reused with only 3/6/12 historical months supplied. This is a stress slice, not more independent real observations, and does not choose or qualify the frozen candidate.

predetermined_acceptance.scope: Engineering forecast acceptance on new-provider actual revenue; not bank repayment/default validation

source_selection_policy: Whole-US Census MRTS was inaccessible without an API key; FRED workaround terms disallowed ML use. These sources were excluded before reading audit observations. The wholly unseen UK ONS source substituted solely for access/licensing; no source was selected on model errors.
limitations: Original aggregate nominal turnover/value indices are observed real revenues normalized to each publisher's base year, not borrower bank receipts or monetary values. Raw index points cannot be pooled across provider bases. Whole-country clusters retain within-country sector and economic-shock dependence. Seven intended audit countries provide limited descriptive uncertainty; current revision vintages are not an unrevised historical backtest. Dates are provider-local, since older-country training observations may follow an audit date. No real expense, repayment, capacity or default labels are present.
freshness_policy: The first v2 external audit was performed before inspecting its labels and is preserved as external-audit-v2-frozen.json/.md. This run is a regression reproduction of consumed labels: the pinned revenue recipe and selected candidate must match before case construction, local exact fitted equality is recorded, and reproduced overall/provider losses must match within 1e-9 absolute tolerance. Cross-platform same-recipe builds need not have identical learned bytes; this reports metric equality at stated precision, not pointwise identical predictions. Changing only net blend/expense/scoring does not make the revenue audit fresh again. No fitting/selection occurs here; a changed revenue recipe requires new reserved external targets.
presentation_only_clarification: Presentation-only clarification after measurement: the narrative identifies the original frozen cohort as consumed evidence. Numeric results, measured timestamp and recorded evaluator SHA256 still identify the original measurement; no fitting or scoring was rerun.
